title: Open the Cloud Link
story: Packets arrive in fragments. Restore the offline ingress conveyor.
lesson: A length prefix tells a decoder how many characters belong to the next message. Keep incomplete data for the next call.
objective: Join the ASCII chunks. Decode decimal-length:payload frames. Return {'messages': [...], 'pending': remainder}. All prefixes are nonnegative decimal integers.
hint: Find ':', parse the length, and stop without consuming data when the payload is incomplete.
